{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
p='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,freight
SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454
SUP-005,363,124.67,189
SUP-006,233,17.23,154
SUP-007,64,57.17,700
SUP-008,373,134.81,599
SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518
'''
rate=Decimal('1.1379'); duty=Decimal('0.0427')
total=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)):
    raw=(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])+Decimal(r['freight']))*rate*(Decimal(1)+duty)
    rounded=raw.quantize(Decimal('.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    total+=rounded
    print(r['record_id'], raw, rounded)
print(len(list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)))), total)
PY"}
